blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Although Doma General Terms and Conditions v3.0 clauses 5.2 and 8.2 state that no administrative or freeze controls operate at the ERC-20 layer, verified deployed Solidity source for Ethereum SDLR TokenContract 0x0b57b7333c43fe900d17a81bddc67c88c825afd6 (sole deployment, 100% of supply, 476,443.336249 SDLR at block 26506037 on 2026-11-27T10:47:11Z, hash 0x53867165de3e65dd0b94c966bc5c30c80465dfdb0020c6c94de03a37b3c753ac) directly implements holder-level blocklisting and global pause. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (held by active EOA 0x9178c5ec0248b2272a111e2cb51674664b19749d) can call addToBlocklist(address) and removeFromBlocklist(address) immediately, emitting AddressBlocklisted(address indexed account) (topic 0xdb9ecf6896ed025e58391b82cd67e321fcb310ee63af415b58efe93c7dde8577) and AddressUnblocklisted(address indexed account) (topic 0x6aa12fece129abcce316cbd448229b1720b8441f5f3e228c9ce0b71a2f21b829). _beforeTokenTransfer reverts with AddressIsBlocklisted for blocklisted senders or recipients on transfers and mints, transferFrom rejects blocklisted spenders, and burnAndRedeem rejects blocklisted owners. PAUSER_ROLE EOA 0xc2769b50d030cfde1db836e918836613a49e82fb can also call pause() globally (paused()=false at pinned block). Deployed code governs over prose and establishes Yes.
